+def _parse_version(version_str):
+    """
+    Parse a version string into a version_info tuple.
+    
+    Examples:
+        "3.4.0" -> (3, 4, 0)
+        "3.4.0.post1" -> (3, 4, 0)
+        "3.4.0rc1" -> (3, 4, 0)
+        "3.4.0+local" -> (3, 4, 0)
+    """
+    # Remove any local version identifier (after +)
+    version_str = version_str.split('+')[0]
+    
+    # Use regex to extract the main version numbers
+    # Match pattern like: X.Y.Z or X.Y or X
+    match = re.match(r'^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?', version_str)
+    if match:
+        major = int(match.group(1))
+        minor = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else 0
+        micro = int(match.group(3)) if match.group(3) else 0
+        return (major, minor, micro)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Cannot parse version string: {version_str}")
